llm_response.reason: The domain jellycat-southafrica.co.za was registered recently (2025) and does not correspond with the long-standing and official Jellycat regional or global domains. The WHOIS info does not show a legitimate South African business entity, and the registrant is hiding their details (registered in Canada). Third-party scam checkers (Scamadviser) rate the site as highly likely to be a scam, with community and trust forum discussions warning about fake Jellycat sellers. No professionally verifiable contact info or business credentials are provided. The website uses the familiar practice of adding a country name to the brand (a known scam tactic) and offers what appear to be abnormally low prices compared to authentic retailers. These features match multiple characteristics of scam websites, including brand impersonation, lack of business legitimacy, and negative third-party validation.
